  "repair_strategy": "Add the autofocus attribute to the close button (#filters-close) so the browser automatically focuses it when the dialog is shown modally.",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "index.html",
      "sha256": "35040e4abd3fd3d69b8d14a7fa857a0ce26fe91b6fe968d195aeaf13432a6d7a",
      "before": "    <button type=\"button\" class=\"btn-close\" id=\"filters-close\" data-bs-dismiss=\"drawer\" aria-label=\"Close\"></button>",
      "after": "    <button type=\"button\" class=\"btn-close\" id=\"filters-close\" data-bs-dismiss=\"drawer\" aria-label=\"Close\" autofocus></button>"
    }
  ],
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "When the Filters drawer opens, the close button receives focus automatically, allowing keyboard users to immediately Tab to the In stock checkbox, toggle it with Space, Tab to Show results, and press Enter to apply filters — all without a mouse.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "If the drawer is ever shown non-modally (via show() instead of showModal()), the autofocus attribute will be ignored, but the drawer defaults to modal.",
    "Only one autofocus per dialog is honored; if another element mistakenly receives autofocus, the close button would not be focused."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "After activating the Filters button with Enter, focus should be on the close button (#filters-close).",
    "Pressing Tab should move focus to the In stock checkbox (#in-stock).",
    "Pressing Space should toggle the checkbox.",
    "Pressing Tab twice should move focus to the Show results button (#apply).",
    "Pressing Enter on Show results should update the applied filter text and close the drawer.",
    "Pressing Escape should close the drawer and return focus to the Filters button."
  ]
}
